modelDescription: The Browning X-Bolt holds a fine reputation as an accurate, reliable rifle that hunters can depend on. Sitting at the summit of the X-Bolt 2 line is the new White Gold Medallion, a rifle built to carry on that legacy with style. The X-Bolt 2 White Gold Medallion was developed for the hunter that prefers the tradition of a wood stock and appreciates the improvements that technology provides. The standout feature is the beautiful Grade V/VI walnut Monte Carlo-style stock with gloss finish and rosewood caps with white line spacer at the fore-end tip and grip cap. Touches like a rounded fore-end tip and point-style checkering retain the classic look, but like other X-Bolt models, this stock has a trim, nimble feel that is fast to the shoulder. A 1-1/4" Inflex recoil pad reduces the impact of felt recoil.
